look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson ten
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 3, lesson T10, exchange platform tour; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: So many boxes
scenes.desc: A generic mock trading terminal assembles panel by panel, labelled as an educational mock.

scenes.name: The overall layout
scenes.desc: Each region of the mock is outlined and numbered: watchlist, symbol bar, chart, order book, order entry, positions, wallet, security.

scenes.name: Find the pair
scenes.desc: Watchlist: typing BTC in the search filters the list; tapping BTC/USDT switches the whole screen to that pair.

scenes.name: The symbol bar
scenes.desc: Symbol bar: symbol, last price and 24-hour change; worked example 60,000 to 61,200 is +2%.

scenes.name: The chart
scenes.desc: Chart: the newest candle forms live; switching 1m to 5m regroups five candles into one.

scenes.name: The order book
scenes.desc: Order book: asks above, bids below, spread 10 USDT; a market buy takes the best ask and the last price ticks up.

scenes.name: Order entry
scenes.desc: Order entry: type, price and size; a limit buy of 0.010 BTC at 60,000 has an order value of 600 USDT; buttons are mock only.

scenes.name: Positions and PnL
scenes.desc: Positions panel: a filled order becomes a long position; unrealized PnL moves +6 / −6 USDT as price moves.

scenes.name: Your wallet
scenes.desc: Wallet: 1,000 USDT balance, 600 in use, 400 available (1x example).

scenes.name: Security settings
scenes.desc: Security drawer: two-factor login, anti-phishing code, withdrawal address list, API keys never shared.

scenes.name: Read the label
scenes.desc: Common mistake: tapping from memory after an app update hits Sell instead of Buy; correction: read the label and check the order.

scenes.name: Find it
scenes.desc: Hotspot hunt: where is unrealized PnL? Countdown, then C, the positions panel; why not the chart.

scenes.name: Stay safe
scenes.desc: Safety rules: check the address, check spot or futures, never explore on a real account, WAIT is always a choice.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T11, spot vs futures.
